content.comment_body: What is the [product_name] AM2 RTD device?
It arrived a few days ago. [url] [article_no] [product_name] AM2 RTD, 2AI, -50..+200 DECR/C I don't have further details. By the way, where did you take that picture?
This photo was taken at an exhibition called "light+building 2010" held in Frankfurt am Main.

Nice photo [user_name]! I have also heard about this. There is more information available on the German forum. In summary, the previous AM2 PT100 module has been updated and will be replaced by the AM2 RTD module. 1) Now supports both Pt100 and Pt1000 sensors 2) The module auto-detects the sensor type 3) Direct replacement—no need to change code or scaling 4) Same price point 5) Offers 2 or 3 wire connections for improved signal quality (especially with 3 wire) 6) Mixing sensors is supported, such as 2 wire Pt100 on one channel and 3 wire Pt1000 on another Pt100 has long been the industry standard, but Pt1000 is increasingly being used in building technology. Let’s keep the information sharing going! Cheers Aaaaarrrggghhh! ("Have a nice day!")
